post.text:
🚨 BREAKING: The DHS funding bill, which allocates $10 BILLION MORE for ICE operations through FY2026, has just PASSED the House of Representatives, 220-207

ICE has EVEN MORE money to boost deportation numbers, with SIX Democrats voting in support, including:

- Cuellar (TX)
- https://t.co/24VaKc8b6E
post.author_description: On-scene covering stories MSM won’t. | Seen on @TuckerCarlson Tonight, Fox News, Newsmax, Timcast, etc. • Donate: https://t.co/HZRuyTRdE9 • media@sortor.us

description.description: A video of a vote on H.R. 7147 in the U.S. House of Representatives. In the first frame, we see the totals in the house chamber, and the vote was successful from most of the Republicans and the Democrats weren't as successful. In the second frame, the Speaker Pro Tempore announced the outcome of the vote. In the final frame, he completes his announcement.
description.ocrText: ON PASSAGE H-R 7147 YEA NAY PRES NV REPUBLICAN 213 1 4 DEMOCRATIC 7 206 INDEPENDENT TOTALS 220 207 4 TIME REMAINING 0:00 REP. SCOTT DesJARLAIS Speaker Pro Tempore

tweetMedia.transcription: On this vote, the Yeazer 220 and the Nazer 207. The bill is passed without objection. A motion to reconsider is laid on the table.
